node.title: Re: eval: Why use the 'Zombie error' idiom?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: See [id://1153468] and the replies, there were/are a few remaining issues even after the major bug was fixed, it seems not until 5.28 - and I'd not trust the eval { ... }; if ($@) { ... } pattern anyway. So I'd always use the eval { ...; 1 } or do { ... } idiom without relying on [doc://$@].
